_note: Name-facts for Uruguay (FT-72, docs/PLAN_V0.12.md). See italy.json for the rules.
Begun with the towns on the continent maps, each as a "city" entry so that a region
of the same id, written later, never shows a town's sentences.

en: Where the name comes from is disputed; one old reading is "I see a mountain", for the hill across its bay.
it: Da dove venga il nome è discusso; un’antica lettura è "vedo un monte", per la collina di fronte alla baia.
